validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real. P7437 is the 114 km / 26-inch sour-gas line inside TotalEnergies' Gas Growth Integrated Project (GGIP) Gas Midstream Project (GMP) at Ar-Ratawi/Artawi, Basra. The EPSCC construction contract for the two/three GMP gas pipelines was awarded to China Petroleum Pipeline Engineering (CPP, a China Petroleum Engineering Corp / CPEC subsidiary) for ~$294m (2.122 bn yuan) in June 2025. Corroborated by multiple INDEPENDENT origins: Pipeline Technology Journal (17 Jun 2025), Shanghai Metal Market/metal.com (Chinese-language, independent), World Oil (15 Sep 2025), and TotalEnergies' own GGIP materials. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct commodity (sour gas -> Gas). PipelineType 'transmission' is defensible for a 114 km midstream trunk, though these are field-to-processing-plant lines (Majnoon and West Qurna 2 -> Artawi/Ratawi plant) that could arguably be gathering/feeder lines; minor caveat only. DUPLICATE CHECK: NOT a duplicate. The project's own spec sentence lists distinct pipes: 'a 114-kilometre sour gas pipeline built with 26-inch diameter pipes, an 83-kilometre, 20-inch sour gas pipeline, and an 83-kilometre, 20-inch sour gas pipeline.' P7437 = the unique 114 km / 26 in line; sister row P7436 = an 83 km / 20 in line. Different length AND diameter, so P7436 and P7437 are genuinely separate pipes, not a relabel/double-count. (Aside for Discovery, not P7437: the source names TWO 83 km / 20 in lines plus 'three more export pipelines', so GEM may be UNDER-counting the 83 km lines under P7436 - flag for the P7436 auditor, not here.) SPEC CAVEAT: the 114 km / 26 in figures appear only in one wording lineage - the Iraq Business News text, reprinted verbatim (identical duplicated-sentence artifact) by Pipeline Technology Journal and BC Insight/CRU. No independent second origin gives the precise per-line dimensions, so treat 114 km / 26 in as medium confidence; no conflicting figure was found.

validity.researcher_notes: OWNER attribution looks wrong. GEM records Owner1 = 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' at 100%, and its cited owner ref (iraq-businessnews.com $294m article) returns HTTP 401 / unverifiable. The GMP (including these pipelines) is an asset of the Gas Growth Integrated Project, whose ownership is well documented as TotalEnergies 45% (operator), Basra Oil Company 30%, and QatarEnergy 25% (TotalEnergies GGIP page; World Oil; offshore-technology). No independent source I found states the pipelines are owned 100% by the Ministry of Oil. Basra Oil Company is a state entity but holds 30%, not 100%, and is distinct from 'Iraq Ministry of Oil'. Recommend Update revisit the owner field against the JV structure (and consider that CPP is the EPSCC contractor, not an owner). Flagged as medium confidence because no source explicitly states the legal owner of the pipe asset itself, only the GGIP JV split.

fills.researcher_notes: ConstructionYear = 2025 carries no ref and I could not cleanly source construction START for this specific pipeline in 2025. What is sourced: the pipeline EPSCC contract was AWARDED to CPP in June 2025 (award, not a pipe-laying start), and the June 2025 Pipeline Technology Journal piece explicitly calls it 'pre-contract phase, subject to confirmation'. The parent 300 Mcf/d GMP plant began construction 'at the beginning of' 2025 per TotalEnergies, but that is the plant, not the 114 km line. Citing a 'pre-contract' source to support a 2025 construction start would be contradictory, so I leave this UNRESOLVED rather than attach a weak/mismatched ref. Recommend Update verify whether pipe construction has physically begun before backing ConstructionYear=2025.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Not stale - well within any dormancy threshold; the project is active and dated evidence is recent. Recorded Status 'proposed' is still DEFENSIBLE for this pipeline package: the EPSCC contract was only awarded June 2025 and the June 2025 source explicitly described it as 'pre-contract phase, final contract terms subject to confirmation' with implementation contingent on formalisation. NEWER evidence (post-dating the sheet's 2025-07-17 update): TotalEnergies' 15 Sep 2025 press release states that following the start of construction of the 300 Mcf/d gas treatment plant earlier in 2025, 'all parts of the multi-energy GGIP project are now in their execution phase' (corroborated by World Oil, 15 Sep 2025). That points to the parent GMP being under construction, but neither source confirms that pipe-laying on the 114 km line specifically has begun. CAVEAT / recommendation for Update: given the awarded EPSCC (Engineering, Procurement, Supply, Construction & Commissioning) contract plus 'execution phase' framing, this row is a strong candidate to move 'proposed' -> 'construction' - but I am NOT staging that change because I lack a source explicitly confirming physical construction of the pipeline itself. Verdict = confirm, flagged for a construction-start check next cycle. Newest independent evidence date: 2025-09.

summary: P7437 (114 km/26 in Artawi GMP line) is REAL and NOT a duplicate of P7436 (83 km/20 in); flags: spec (StartYear3 2027 should be 2028), attribution (Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' 100% likely wrong -> GGIP JV Total/BOC/QatarEnergy), spec caveat (114 km/26 in single-origin lineage); status 'proposed' confirmed but a construction candidate.
